THE SUPERVISOR'S 'EXHAUSTED SAME-CHARTER WORK' GUARD IS DEAD CODE, BECAUSE jq's // OPERATOR TREATS LITERAL false AS EMPTY. Read at .github/workflows/factory-supervisor.yml:277 and reproduced locally with jq 1.7 this run: the guard evaluates `jq -r '.continue_recommended // true' <<<"$raw"` and compares the result to the string false, but `echo '{"continue_recommended":false}' | jq -r '.continue_recommended // true'` prints `true`, because jq's alternative operator falls through on false as well as on null. The guard can therefore NEVER fire, and any team whose lab/frontier/<team>.json says continue_recommended:false is re-dispatched forever. Observed live: frontier-counter-label-integrity was dispatched at 06:35Z (run 38862093221, cancelled) and again at 07:47Z (run 38869446783) while its accepted branch state already read charter_version 1, cycle_status TERMINATE, continue_recommended false -- producing at least nine no-change verification cycles and eight producer-authored audit placement copies. The identical pattern is on line 230 for the CORE lanes' .continue_recommended check, so a core lane can also be re-dispatched after it declares itself exhausted. .github/** is control-plane scope and is NOT edited from a lane, a team or the director. ROUTE-AROUND, and this is the standing rule rather than a one-off fix: the portfolio .status field is the ONLY reliable stop, because the dispatch query at line 261 is `select(.status=="RUN")`, a plain string comparison the jq defect does not touch. Set a discharged or exhausted team's status to TERMINATED; do not rely on continue_recommended, do not rely on a blocker file, and do not re-dispatch it. Intended upstream fix for the control-plane maintainer: test the field with `jq -r 'if .continue_recommended == false then "false" else "true" end'` (or `.continue_recommended | tostring`), never with //.
